svg.title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory

cc:Work.dc:title: Latest Scriptw versus V8: elapsed time and process memory
cc:Work.dc:description: Latest verified Scriptw versus V8, all 17 fresh Store/Realm workloads. Measured 2026-10-25 11:11 UTC; compiler 9b7746531c4b3bff0ecbb863d7d70dfead12455b. Lower is better. Paired bars use a shared zero-based linear scale within each section: median elapsed milliseconds and median post-execution process RSS in MiB. RSS includes host/runtime, setup and retained warmup effects; it is not live JavaScript heap usage or a peak. Each runtime has 14 measured observations from two rounds of seven after ten warmups. Existing-Realm calls are separate. Source report SHA-256: a6504948d3f1549698d1d650cea84452df5a3f229a3a231c0f9c44d741f27950. Archive SHA-256: 3e18aa86ce7703e935f7a5c6dcfe1a628f98817a567b6f56a6b42d3ce0585e52. sort-reverse-128.js: V8 0.017 ms, Scriptw 2.371 ms; V8 RSS 52.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 297.1 MiB. sort-reverse-512.js: V8 0.087 ms, Scriptw 8.576 ms; V8 RSS 53.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 305.2 MiB. sort-sorted-512.js: V8 0.086 ms, Scriptw 6.753 ms; V8 RSS 53.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 305.1 MiB. to-sorted-512.js: V8 0.088 ms, Scriptw 7.118 ms; V8 RSS 53.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 305.3 MiB. join-1024.js: V8 0.045 ms, Scriptw 7.903 ms; V8 RSS 53.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 306.6 MiB. join-4096.js: V8 0.603 ms, Scriptw 29.364 ms; V8 RSS 61.6 MiB, Scriptw RSS 305.0 MiB. join-mixed-1024.js: V8 0.180 ms, Scriptw 8.402 ms; V8 RSS 59.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 305.2 MiB. numeric-loop-10000.js: V8 0.173 ms, Scriptw 1.454 ms; V8 RSS 59.0 MiB, Scriptw RSS 290.8 MiB. numeric-loop-50000.js: V8 0.744 ms, Scriptw 4.154 ms; V8 RSS 61.1 MiB, Scriptw RSS 290.8 MiB. folded-string-4096.js: V8 0.341 ms, Scriptw 1.869 ms; V8 RSS 59.3 MiB, Scriptw RSS 292.8 MiB. dynamic-string-4096.js: V8 0.436 ms, Scriptw 2.951 ms; V8 RSS 60.8 MiB, Scriptw RSS 291.1 MiB. integer.js: V8 1.689 ms, Scriptw 4.465 ms; V8 RSS 59.9 MiB, Scriptw RSS 291.1 MiB. objects.js: V8 0.047 ms, Scriptw 4.912 ms; V8 RSS 53.7 MiB, Scriptw RSS 301.3 MiB. retained-objects.js: V8 2.302 ms, Scriptw 398.091 ms; V8 RSS 71.1 MiB, Scriptw RSS 317.4 MiB. join-empty-1024.js: V8 0.137 ms, Scriptw 2.554 ms; V8 RSS 58.5 MiB, Scriptw RSS 295.0 MiB. join-singleton-1024.js: V8 0.112 ms, Scriptw 2.702 ms; V8 RSS 59.4 MiB, Scriptw RSS 294.9 MiB. join-small-1024.js: V8 0.194 ms, Scriptw 3.465 ms; V8 RSS 57.4 MiB, Scriptw RSS 295.2 MiB.
